title: Entry criteria in an unknown format are accepted, then the blueprint catches every ticket
env: TAVI: staging-desk.taviportal.com, org Anyware, owner, QA WF Dept R (QA blueprint + ticket #966, deleted after) · Zoho: Zoho Desk Enterprise trial, Setup › Blueprint › Create Blueprint (read only)

panels.caption: TAVI API: criteria in the workflow-rule format → 201 Created; non-matching ticket enters
Zoho Create Blueprint: Specific Records (conditions) or All Records is an explicit choice
TAVI ticket #966 "QA BP N2 other subject" is inside the blueprint, Status locked
TAVI designer of the same blueprint: Criteria says "Tickets that match", Status Active

rows: Saving entry criteria the app cannot read
Criteria are built in Setup from field pickers (Specific Records + conditions). Saving unreadable criteria through an API: not checked.
The API accepts a criteria body in another format (the workflow-rule shape {kind, operator, stringValue}) and answers 201 Created. No error.
A ticket that does not match the criteria
Only records that meet the conditions enter the blueprint (Specific Records).
Ticket #966 "QA BP N2 other subject" does not start with "QA BP N2-ONLY " but enters the blueprint at Open; its Status is locked by it.
Applying a blueprint to every ticket
"All Records" is a separate, visible choice: "The Blueprint will be applied to all records."
The designer still shows Criteria "Tickets that match" while the blueprint behaves as all tickets, so the admin cannot see it.
